cut: Add transactional undo/redo for source and project edits. Depends on DA29-095, DA29-096, and DA29-181.
acceptance: Multi-step edits, file writes, asset refs, undo/redo branches, save/reopen, failure compensation, size caps, and crash recovery preserve bytes and revisions.
claimCeiling: unit/static structural closeout; not full product parity
